title: Line sketch: Vortex of Fiery Whorls
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An abstract composition of intertwining, wave-like forms that create a sense of fluid motion across the entire page. Bold, undulating lines in warm hues twist and overlap, evoking organic flow. The technique appears to be fluid pouring or marbling, with smooth color transitions and high contrast between dark and vibrant tones (derived from painting #137).
